SimpleBan 1.0.0 updated for Minecraft 26.3 and Java 25.

Requires Paper 26.3 and Java 25. Copy `SimpleBan-1.0.0.jar` into the server's
`plugins/` directory and restart the server. Configure the generated plugin
configuration and permissions before use.

The JAR is built from this release tag with `mvn -B -ntp clean verify`.
`SHA256SUMS` contains its SHA-256 checksum. Compilation and the Maven verification
lifecycle passed; an in-game server test was not performed.
